description: This file defines React components for managing inbox API keys in the Notesnook application, including listing, viewing, copying, revoking, and creating API keys with expiration options.

classes.name: ApiKeyItem
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing individual API keys, including viewing, copying, and revoking.

classes.name: AddApiKeyDialog
classes.description: Dialog component for creating a new inbox API key with expiration options.

methods.name: InboxApiKeys
methods.description: Main React component for listing and managing all inbox API keys.

methods.name: viewKey
methods.description: Prompts for password verification and then displays the API key.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the API key to clipboard if viewing is enabled.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles creation of a new API key with selected expiration.
